item.text: {"confident":true,"explanation":"By De Morgan's law, negate both parts and change “and” to “or.” The negation of 0≤2 is 0>2, and the negation of “4.3 is not irrational” is “4.3 is irrational.”","answers":[{"key":"selection","correct_option":"a","correct_value":"$0>2$ or $4.3$ is irrational","value_type":"text","wrong_value":null,"correct_keys":[],"wrong_keys":[]}]}
